verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official CLI at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. That CLI is first-party tooling from the same vendor and covers the Stripe API that Issuing is part of, but the pack only shows that the CLI exists, with no detail on what it can do. missing for 10: evidence of Issuing-specific CLI commands (cards, cardholders, authorizations, test purchases), any documentation of AI-native or agent workflows through the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
